text: what do you need for the next queue item
reply: The headline queue item is the art pass: PixelLab art for the seven placeholder guardians, Haar Wyrm first. It needs one thing from you: set PIXELLAB_API_KEY in this PC's environment and restart the app. Everything else is ready: the budget (about 650 of your remaining generations), the order, and style-guide section 8. The key is still not set in any scope here, so this pass did the item below it instead, porting tools/screenshot.sh to run without xvfb.

text: Is the Haar hydra's breath weapon supposed to be steam?
reply: Shipped in pass 499 (#557). MistBreath is now SteamBreath: a slow (95 px/s) gout that vents from the jaws, narrow at the mouth and billowing wider, hotter and whiter than the fog with a heat shimmer, slow enough to dodge (jump it or stand on the tank walls). The tell leaks wisps and a rising hiss; a doused head goes out with a hiss and a last puff; the dry tanks steam. Story carried through the bible (8.4, the Stillstone lines, the fog-lifts event row), Ilka and the Haar Spring signs: the wyrm is steam and bone, it boiled the tanks dry, and the Haar's fog is its steam cooled over the marsh. New steam SFX; four new tests; full suite green. The base redraw as a steam wyrm stays with the next art pass (and takes your horn note below).

text: The 3/4 view is off. The far horn is curled backward instead of toward the muzzle.
reply: Fixed in art pass 9 — a fresh review picture is on the Shots tab (haar-wyrm-base-for-approval.png). The base is redrawn as the steam-and-bone wyrm (pro, 15 generations): now both horns rise from the crown and curve forward over the brow toward the muzzle, a matched pair in the east profile and the three-quarter alike, so the far horn no longer curls the wrong way and the two views agree. It also reads paler and more bleached (steam, not fog). First retake came out multi-headed because the prompt said 'three-headed serpent' — discarded, and the lesson ('name only the part the sprite is, not the whole creature') is now in the style guide. No animation until you OK this base; approve or flag it on the Shots tab. Open question still waiting for you: keep the three heads code-drawn (this becomes a portrait/intro look only), or move the solid head onto the sheet while the coil and necks stay code?
